briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind accelerate frontier model releases as compute bottlenecks intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a high-stakes phase with multiple frontier labs shipping advanced reasoning models. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced multi-step reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4.1 shows gains in long-context tasks while DeepSeek R2 challenges cost-performance curves in open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New red-team reports highlight agentic workflow exploits.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC securing additional capacity. Microsoft and Google announce joint hyperscale cluster expansions in Texas and Singapore.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols become the decisive moat before 2028?
